topic: Why kindness can feel threatening (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
Kindness does not always feel good.

For some people, kindness from others or from themselves brings up discomfort. Research links fear of self-compassion and fear of receiving kindness with mental health difficulties, and it often made sense once.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile @equal_psychology, and the full article is linked in bio.

Research:

Gilbert, P., McEwan, K., Matos, M., & Rivis, A. (2011). Fears of compassion: Development of three self-report measures. Psychology and Psychotherapy. https://doi.org/10.1348/147608310X526511
